messages:
Nina: quick flag 16A8 I'm hitting a Vercel build error when importing the JS SDK from Next middleware: `Can't resolve 'fs'` even though middleware is edge-only. anyone seen this?

Omar: yup. it's the conditional exports + CJS fallback problem. Next's resolver sometimes picks the cjs path which pulls node deps. Two quick dev workarounds: 1) lazy/dynamic import inside the handler, or 2) import the edge bundle path if available (e.g. `@redwood/sdk/edge`).

Lee: TS annoyances too: edge Request/Response types differ from node globals. I fixed `Property 'json' does not exist on type 'Request'` by adding "lib": ["es2021","dom"] and removing `@types/node` for edge files, or add a small `edge.d.ts` to augment Request.

Nina: any stable plan on the SDK side?

Omar: we're prototyping an explicit `/edge` export and a tiny ESM-only bundle with zero node imports. package.json exports will include "./edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs". That should stop bundlers from pulling in fs/stream shims.

Lee: extra gotcha: some telemetry/transitive deps still import node builtins at top-level. we replaced a telemetry helper with a no-op in the edge bundle to avoid surprises.

Nina: thanks, lazy import works for now. please publish a dist tag when the edge build is available.

devex-bot: created issue #710 in redwood-js-sdk: "Add /edge export + Next middleware troubleshooting guide" https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/issues/710
